summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, announcing an agreement to sell its Baffin Limited subsidiary, a Canadian performance footwear brand, to L.P. Royer Inc., a Canadian manufacturer of work and military footwear. No financial terms were disclosed. Canada Goose acquired Baffin in 2018 to enter footwear; the sale aims to simplify operations and focus on its own footwear line launched in 2021. The transaction is expected to close in August 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. No advisor or board recommendation was mentioned. Watch for closing announcement and any regulatory approvals.
